verdict.rationale: ADK documents a Tool Confirmation (HITL) flow that guards tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input, plus callbacks to hook into execution lifecycle for custom guardrails — giving some control over what tools can do. However, there is no evidence of a fine-grained permission system (e.g., per-tool allow/deny scopes) or of sandboxed/isolated execution environments for tool calls; deployment options (Cloud Run, GKE, container) are about hosting, not tool sandboxing. Missing for 10: documented fine-grained tool permission/authorization model, explicit sandboxed code-execution isolation, and independent verification of these safety controls.
